The first document about

Kings

Introduction

The first document of Kings is a continuation of the story about the kingdom of the Israilitas which started in the document of Samwil. It is divided into three: 1/ The taking_place of Sulumun as a king of nation of Israil, and the death of his father Dabid. 2/ The kinging by Sulumun and his successes, especially the making of the temple of Hirusalim. 3/ The division of the kingdom of Israil into two: the northern (LIT on the left_side) kingdom, and the southern (LIT on the right_side) kingdom, and the stories about the kings (who) led them until nine hundred fifty (950) years before Jesus was_born.

Here in two documents concerning Kings, each leader was_judged according to their faithfulness to God (MS Manama), and (it's) found_out that the success of the entire nation depends_on (LIT goes_along_with) his faithfulness. Worshiping of false_gods and disobedience, can_cause (LIT can_give) destruction/disaster. And all kings of the northern (LIT on the left of east) kingdom didn't succeed in this testing. But there_(were) kings of the southern (LIT on the right side) kingdom who succeeded in this test, and there (were) also those who didn't.

And the people who are well_known in the First documents of Kings, were the prophets of the Lord God who_were courageous tellers of the word of God who warned the people not to worship false_gods, and not to disobey God. Especially Ilyas and the story about his countering the prophets of Baal (chapter 18).
